alt: Petpogo PetPhone AI pet collar ecosystem product photo showing the compact wearable device alongside its companion app and PetCam components
story: At IFA 2026 in Berlin, Petpogo unveiled the upgraded PetPhone, a pet collar marketed as 'the world's first AI smartphone for pets' that uses a vocalization model trained on millions of animal sounds to translate pet emotions into human language, supports two-way PetChat audio, and theoretically lets pets initiate calls on their own.
why_funny: Petpogo applied the full smartphone product stack — calls, AI emotion insights, geo-fencing, push notifications, companion app — to an animal that cannot read, speak, or dial.
